documents.title: Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Recording - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results, Limited Review Report for September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited presented its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, reporting standalone gross revenues of Rs 1,386.07 crs and consolidated gross revenues of Rs 1,492.79 crs. Management estimated the capex for FY27 to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs. The company highlighted key strategic focus areas including growing exports, ramping up renewable and casting facilities, and improving ROCE and RONW. Management reported a strong financial performance for Q4 FY26 with a 23% revenue increase and a 45% growth in PAT, driven by favorable domestic demand tailwinds from GST 2.0 and growth in exports. The company crossed INR 5,000 crores in revenue for the full year, supported by stable commodity prices and better working capital management that reduced inventory and debtor days.

guidance.claim: Capex for FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

guidance.claim: Management estimates the optimum revenue potential out of existing investments in existing plants to be about INR 6,000 crores to INR 6,500 crores.
guidance.quote: So I would probably say, yes, about INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the visibility right now is about 1 month due to the continuously changing environment.
demand_outlook.quote: But currently, if you ask me, the visibility is about 1 month. The visibility right now is fairly low because of the continuously changing environment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent about INR 261 crores towards capex last year.
capex_expansion.quote: In terms of capex, last year, we basically spent about INR261 crores towards capex, which is both in terms of investment towards the windmill business, aluminium business and a little bit of the off-road businesses and some routine capex and cost savings totalling INR261 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex of FY26 was mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium and steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA percentage stood at 7.79% in Q1 FY27 compared to 7.51% in Q1 FY26.
The present interest cost is around INR 26 crores to INR 27 crores a quarter, totalling about INR 111 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: See, the present interest cost is around INR26 crores, INR27 crores a quarter, totalling about INR111 crores for the whole year.

orders_capacity.claim: Passenger car steel wheels capacity between the company and its subsidiary is about 11 million to 12 million.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you take passenger car, steel wheels between us and our subsidiary, if I look at it combined, I think Wheels India has got a capacity of about 4 million and the subsidiary has got a capacity of about 7 million. So about 11 million to 12 million is the capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Aluminium wheels capacity currently stands at about 42,000 per month.
orders_capacity.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month.

capital_allocation.claim: Debtor days were reduced from 61 to 54.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debtor days from 61 to 54.

capital_allocation.claim: Free Cash Flow stands at 83Crs in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Free Cash Flow (FCF) stands at 83Crs in FY26

capital_allocation.claim: Debt is maintained at FY25 levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt is maintained at FY25 levels.

risks_headwinds.claim: Aluminium prices have gone up and the company had to re-source major quantities previously bought from the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: Aluminium, we were buying major quantities from the Middle East. So we had to re-source and also aluminium prices have gone up.

management_commitments.claim: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
management_commitments.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

management_commitments.claim: Management expects double-digit EBITDA to happen from strategy and loss-making businesses becoming positive within 1 or 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: So I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA. I don't think it should take longer than that.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
